scope: Actual browser editor/resolver/clipboard diagnostics; prepared host and scheduler; no optional-runtime or memory qualification
memoryMethod: CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage then Performance.getMetrics, Runtime.getHeapUsage and Memory.getDOMCounters; post-disposal; no process/native peak claim
liveMemoryMethod: CDP phase snapshots without explicit GC; sampled JS heap/backing-storage/DOM high-water only, not process/native or true peak

processMemory.scope: Browser tree sampled resident/physical-footprint bytes; OS-maintained per-process lifetime maximum physical footprint. Not a simultaneous tree peak, cycle-local peak, JS allocation peak or plateau qualification.
